verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents a RESTful API with a published v2.0 spec (index.yaml) covering directory, device and group operations, plus a PowerShell module and official GitHub API examples. A community report about rotated API keys confirms the API is used in practice. The standard OpenAPI paths returned 404, but the spec is published at a different path, so this does not contradict the documented API. missing for 10: evidence of auth and rate-limit documentation depth, AI-friendly doc formats (llms.txt and markdown docs at docs.jumpcloud.com returned 404).
